name: Demo · blocked UWB link
frame: Synthetic lander-centred east-north-up, aligned to DE421 mean Earth

ravineLength_m.source: Synthetic route or assumed observation spacing

climb_m.source: Synthetic route or assumed observation spacing

motionH_m.source: Planning allowance; LL reports ATE / trajectory length = 1%, RMSE and alignment unconfirmed. No automatic conversion.

motionU_m.source: Planning allowance; no separate vertical test statistic supplied.

initH_m.source: Planning allowance; rover deployment measurement is unspecified.

initU_m.source: Planning allowance; rover deployment measurement is unspecified.

landerH_m.source: Planning allowance including shared map control; Collins et al. 2026, doi:10.3390/rs18030525.

landerU_m.source: Planning allowance; Henriksen et al. 2016, doi:10.5194/isprsarchives-XLI-B4-397-2016. Not a reported absolute sigma.

heading_deg.source: Planning allowance conditional on an independent initial heading measurement. Aligned ATE does not specify heading accuracy.

rangeSigma_m.source: Accepted line-of-sight range allowance; Chen et al. 2022, doi:10.3390/rs14174258. Not a conversion from paper RMSE.

maxRange_m.source: Synthetic demonstration input; no performance claim

uwbSpacing_m.source: Synthetic route or assumed observation spacing

matchSigma_m.source: Planning allowance; WARG (arXiv:2606.10602) reports 1.68 m real-data and 3.63 m domain-transfer errors, not per-axis sigma.

mapControl_m.source: Shared horizontal control allowance; Collins et al. 2026 reports latitude offset spreads up to 22.4 m against uncertain references.

mapSpacing_m.source: Synthetic route or assumed observation spacing

assumptions.source: User-set planning inputs; no flight performance claim
assumptions.statistic: one standard deviation; horizontal values per axis
assumptions.growth: Independent motion increments: variance = sigma100^2 * distance_walked / 100 m
assumptions.attitude: Gravity-aligned roll and pitch; first-order initial yaw error
assumptions.control: Lander horizontal sigma includes shared map control when landerFromMap is true; otherwise priors are independent
assumptions.availability: UWB blocked behind the synthetic ravine bend; enabled available map matches succeed
assumptions.height: Geometric up from the synthetic local tangent plane; no lunar terrain or frame transform applied
assumptions.landing: Lander position knowledge describes the achieved position, not landing dispersion
